title: The Compiler May Read It, the Agent May Not: Keeping Part of a Research Code Away from a Coding Agent

paragraphs.en: The compiler must read modules a physics-based solver cannot build without; the coding agent must not read that intellectual property. The harness does not ship that rule. We classified fifteen read routes against a container, permission rules and a sandbox. None of the three can tell which program is reading.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器必须读取物理基求解器无法构建所必需的模块；编码智能体不得读取该知识产权。 测试框架并未包含该规则。 我们针对一个容器、权限规则和沙盒，对十五条读取路径进行了分类。 三者都无法判断是哪个程序在执行读取操作。

sents.en: The compiler must read modules a physics-based solver cannot build without; the coding agent must not read that intellectual property.
sents.zh: 编译器必须读取物理基求解器无法构建所必需的模块；编码智能体不得读取该知识产权。

sents.en: The harness does not ship that rule.
sents.zh: 测试框架并未包含该规则。

sents.en: We classified fifteen read routes against a container, permission rules and a sandbox.
sents.zh: 我们针对一个容器、权限规则和沙盒，对十五条读取路径进行了分类。

sents.en: None of the three can tell which program is reading.
sents.zh: 三者都无法判断是哪个程序在执行读取操作。

paragraphs.en: We run a coding agent on a physics-based numerical code, a flow solver for the partial differential equations of fluid motion. Solvers of this kind are commonly built on an open-source base, the discretization and the parallel machinery, completed by a group’s own material and reaction models. Those models are the constitutive and kinetic closures that make the governing equations solvable. They can hold a group’s intellectual property ahead of publication, and some are licensed to the group under terms that allow generating publishable data but not passing on the algorithms themselves. A read by the agent puts their bytes into a transcript that leaves the machine. The solver does not build without them. Consequently the compiler has to open those files. The rule we wanted is simple to state: the compiler may read those files but the agent may not. Four mechanisms stand between the agent and the files: a) the container the agent runs in dictates the runtime user and the paths mounted for the agent; b) the agent’s permission rules match on the text of a command and on a path; c) the harness’s sandbox matches on a path; d) the plain-language instruction file that the agent reads at the start of every session is a soft contract that can state the rule in full but does not enforce it. Out of the box, none of the four can state the criterion the rule turns on, which is which program is reading.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个基于物理的数值代码上运行一个编码智能体，该代码是一个用于流体运动偏微分方程的流求解器。 这类求解器通常构建在开源基础之上，包括离散化和并行处理机制，并由团队自行补充材料模型和反应模型。 这些模型是构成性和动力学闭合项，使得控制方程得以求解。 在发表之前，它们可以承载团队的知识产权；其中一些模型根据特定条款授权给团队，允许生成可发表的数据，但禁止传递算法本身。 智能体的一次读取操作会将其字节数据写入一份离开机器的转录文本中。 没有这些模型，求解器就无法构建。 因此，编译器必须打开这些文件。 我们希望实现的规则表述很简单：编译器可以读取这些文件，但智能体不可以。 智能体与这些文件之间存在四种机制：a) 智能体运行的容器决定了运行时的用户身份以及为智能体挂载的路径；b) 智能体的权限规则会匹配命令文本和路径；c) 执行框架的沙箱会匹配特定路径；d) 智能体在每次会话开始时读取的普通语言指令文件是一份软性合同，可以完整陈述该规则，但无法强制执行。 默认情况下，这四种机制中没有任何一种能够明确说明该规则所依据的判断标准，即究竟是哪条程序在执行读取操作。

paragraphs.en: We use two terms in a specific sense. The harness is the program that runs the language model and executes its tool calls. By the agent we mean everything the harness drives: the model’s context, the agent’s own file-reading tools, the shell it starts and every process descended from that shell, the hook scripts the harness runs on the agent’s behalf, and any policy server it is configured to call. All of them can put text in front of the model. By may not read we mean that the bytes of a protected file must not reach the model’s context or the transcript through any of them. We allow one channel only, for the sake of operating the solver. A compiler diagnostic may quote the line it rejects, and we accept that. We do not accept the compiler’s other output modes, which can print a file in its entirety. Written out, the rule is that the compiler may open the protected files, that its object code and its diagnostics may reach the agent, and that the files themselves may not, by any path. Both permitted outputs still carry content derived from the file, the diagnostic in the line it quotes and the object code in the models’ constants. The rule is therefore a bounded disclosure and not noninterference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以特定含义使用两个术语。 Harness 是运行语言模型并执行其工具调用的程序。 我们所说的智能体，指的是 harness 所驱动的一切：模型的上下文、智能体自身的文件读取工具、它启动的 shell 以及由此 shell 派生出的所有进程、harness 代表智能体运行的钩子脚本，以及它被配置为调用的任何策略服务器。 它们都可以向模型输入文本。 “可能无法读取”指的是受保护文件的字节数据不得通过任何途径进入模型的上下文或转录记录。 为了运行求解器，我们仅允许一个通道。 编译器诊断信息可以引用其拒绝的那一行，这一点我们接受。 我们不接受编译器的其他输出模式，因为这些模式可能会完整打印整个文件。 具体而言，该规则规定：编译器可以打开受保护文件，其目标代码和诊断信息可以到达智能体，但文件本身不得通过任何路径进入智能体。 这两种允许的输出仍然包含源自该文件的内容：诊断信息中引用了该行，而目标代码则存在于模型的常量中。 因此，该规则属于有限披露，而非非干扰原则。

paragraphs.en: We take the position of an ordinary user of the agent. Such a user cannot change the harness, cannot load a kernel security policy, which lives in the host kernel that every container shares, and cannot replace the language runtime. Accordingly every negative result below is relative to that position. The negative results do not bind an administrator with root on the host machine, who can install a kernel-level enforcer. What this article examines is what these mechanisms can express and cover and what they cannot. It does not examine how they hold against a designated adversary. The sidebar gives the threat model and the parts we trust.

paragraphs.en: Threat Model and Trusted Components We do not treat the model or the harness as hostile. However, the boundary cannot rest on the agent’s cooperation either, because a tool call can follow from a misreading of the task, from a misfired model output, or from text the agent reads in a file and acts on. The parts that have to be trusted are the kernel and the container runtime, the vendor’s harness and the model service behind it, the compiler, and any hook or policy server we install ourselves. The build files have to be trusted as well, because a build recipe the agent can edit, or pass flags to, can print a protected file. That trust holds if the recipe and its flags are out of the agent’s reach. In this deployment the instruction file can place them there, but it enforces nothing, which is why a recipe under an allowed build target is among the routes no mechanism covers.
paragraphs.zh: 威胁模型与可信组件：我们不将模型或执行框架视为敌对实体。 然而，边界也不能仅依赖智能体的合作，因为工具调用可能源于对任务的误读、模型输出的错误，或是智能体从文件中读取并据此行动的文字内容。 必须信任的组件包括内核和容器运行时、供应商的执行框架及其背后的模型服务、编译器，以及我们自行安装的任何钩子或策略服务器。 构建文件也必须可信，因为智能体可以编辑或向其传递参数的构建脚本，可能会生成受保护的文件。 如果该构建脚本及其参数超出智能体的控制范围，这种信任关系就成立。 在此部署方案中，指令文件可以将这些组件置于该位置，但它本身并不强制执行任何限制，因此位于允许构建目标下的构建脚本，正是没有任何机制能够覆盖的路径之一。

The second is a table of fifteen ways the agent can reach a protected file, classified against the configuration we run, in which the permission rules and the sandbox cover different routes, and five routes are covered by neither. The third is the history of one deny list over five weeks, whose four revisions, made in the course of ordinary use, added 118, 13, 4 and finally zero new command names. paragraphs.en: The security literature calls this rule purpose-based access control . It permits or refuses an access according to what the access is for. The term was presented by Byun and Li [ 1 ] , who list three ways a system can learn the purpose of an access. The first is to ask the requester, which “requires complete trust on the users”. The second is to register an application with a fixed purpose, which “cannot be used for complex stored-procedures or applications as they may access various data for multiple purposes”. The third is to infer the purpose, which the authors judge as being hard to do accurately. The instruction file is the first. paragraphs.en: The idea of deciding a read by which program is doing the reading has been documented before, under the name type enforcement . Boebert and Kain put each running program in a domain and each file in a type, and wrote down in a table what every domain may do to every type [ 2 ] . An entry left out of the table was a refusal, and because the table was finite and explicit an auditor could check the whole policy by reading it. A list of forbidden command names has neither property. It permits whatever it omits, and at the length such lists reach nobody can check it by reading. Linux carries type enforcement in the kernel as SELinux, which moves a process into a new domain when it executes a program of a given type. If the protected files are given a type that the agent’s domain cannot read, the kernel refuses the agent while the compiler proceeds, at the cost of a privileged policy loader and a kernel we do not administer.

paragraphs.en: The broker approximates the rule rather than enforcing it, and the approximation has two costs. The first is that the build’s own output carries bytes from the protected files. A compiler diagnostic quotes the line it rejects, and preprocessed source carries far more than a line. The filter on the reply is therefore the actual security control. Widening it lets more of the protected file back through. Our own arrangement already concedes the diagnostic, since it lets the agent read one while refusing it the file. The second cost is the edit-build-fix loop, which is the reason to put an agent on a research code at all. A broker that answers only pass or fail removes that loop. One that returns the failure message hands back the offending line. In addition, someone other than the agent has to own the recipe, so build engineering moves back to a person. The broker is the right choice where the protected files are stable and separate from the code the agent edits, but where they are themselves under development it removes the loop the agent was brought in for. Our result is therefore narrow. The controls this harness exposes cannot express the rule, and a separately trusted mediator outside the harness can only approximate it.

paragraphs.en: For the vendor we use, its own documentation states that the permission rules and the sandbox do not cover the same things. On some routes no check runs at all. The second case is what the security literature calls a failure of complete mediation , complete mediation being the principle that every access to every object is checked [ 4 ] .

paragraphs.en: We classified fifteen prospective ways of getting the protected bytes into the agent’s context against the configuration we run, in Table I , which gives the command for each. Two of them are direct reads that any deny list would name. Three are taken from a 2003 catalogue of indirect paths to a resource [ 5 ] . Three others come from the vendor’s own statements of what its sandbox does not cover [ 3 ] , while three are shell constructs from the author’s earlier published disclosure. One was shown publicly with this same agent, by invoking the dynamic linker on a binary an enforcement rule named [ 6 ] . The last three are consequences of the rule set itself. One is a build target the rules allow, whose recipe reads the file. Another is the compiler, which the rules must allow, invoked in an output mode that prints the file instead of compiling it. The third is the repository’s own history. The protected files are under version control and the repository sits in the agent’s tree, so the version-control tool can print any of them at a revision, addressed by a path relative to the repository that no rule names.

paragraphs.en: Neither the permission rules nor the sandbox covers what the other covers. Two routes are covered by both, seven by the sandbox alone, one by the permission rules alone, and five by neither, as Fig. 1 shows. Hence neither mechanism suffices on its own, and their union cannot be expressed as one policy through the interfaces this harness gives us. The one route only the permission rules cover is the agent’s built-in file-read tool, which the sandbox’s documented scope leaves out. The seven the sandbox alone covers evade the command match in one of three ways. Either the read presents no command token to match, or the token it presents is not the protected path, or the program it names is not the name on the list. The five that neither covers are a) a recipe under a build target the agent is allowed to run; b) a read performed by a policy server the agent talks to over the Model Context Protocol; c) a read performed by a hook, which is a script the harness runs on the agent’s behalf at fixed points; d) the compiler itself, asked to preprocess a protected file rather than to compile it; and e) the version-control tool, asked for the file at a revision rather than at its path. Each is a program the agent causes to run, with the agent’s authority, through a name the rules have already permitted. The compiler route matters most. A direct read is refused while gfortran -E f is not, though the compiler names the path as plainly as cat does. The build cannot run unless the compiler is permitted to read the file. That permission is what the route uses.

paragraphs.en: We kept one deny list under revision for five weeks, with the protection target held still at two paths. Four dated revisions took the rule count from 14 to 488, 540, 556 and 586. The first three added 118, 13 and 4 new command names, taking the distinct names from 10 to 128, 141 and 145. The fourth added 30 rules and no new name; this is the informative one. Fifteen commands already on the list had been guarded on the directory but not on the single file, and the revision extended them to the file. None of the fifteen opened a new path to the file’s contents. What the revision fixed was a missing invariant rather than a missing command. The two targets had separate, hand-maintained lists. The generator’s own comment described a relation between them that nothing checked. Each rule names one command and one target, so the rule language has no way to say that two targets must be protected alike, and that is how the gap went unnoticed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们持续修订了一份拒绝列表长达五周，期间保护目标始终维持在两个路径。 四次日期标注的修订使规则数量从 14 增至 488、540、556 和 586。 前三次修订分别新增了 118、13 和 4 个命令名称，使唯一名称总数从 10 增至 128、141 和 145。 第四次修订增加了 30 条规则，但没有新增名称；这一修订具有说明意义。 列表中已有的十五个命令此前已对目录进行了保护，但尚未保护单个文件，此次修订将它们扩展至文件层面。 这十五个命令中没有任何一个为文件内容开辟了新的路径。 此次修订修正的其实是一个缺失的不变量，而非缺失的命令。 这两个目标各自拥有独立且由人工维护的列表。 生成器自身的注释描述了它们之间的关系，但这一关系并未经过任何验证。 每条规则都指定一个命令和一个目标，因此规则语言无法表达“两个目标必须受到同等保护”这一要求，正因如此，这个漏洞才未被察觉。

paragraphs.en: None of the mechanisms this harness exposes names the consumer of a read. They name a user account, a path, or the spelling of a command, and the one artifact that does name a purpose, the instruction file, enforces nothing. Research systems do name the consumer, by process lineage [ 7 ] or by a bounded access episode [ 8 ] , but each asks for a runtime, a kernel or an execution environment that an ordinary user does not own. This deployment has no place to enforce the requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 这个工具集所暴露的任何机制都没有指明读取操作的使用者。 它们命名的是用户账户、路径或命令的拼写，而唯一确实指明了用途的组件——指令文件——却没有任何强制作用。 研究系统确实会指明使用者，通过进程谱系 [ 7 ] 或受限制的访问时段 [ 8 ] ，但每种方式都需要一个运行时、内核或执行环境，而这些是普通用户并不拥有的。 这种部署方式没有地方可以强制执行该要求。

paragraphs.en: A check that could enforce the rule would be made when a file is opened, would know which program will consume the bytes, and would have four properties:
paragraphs.zh: 在打开文件时，会执行一项检查以强制执行该规则；这项检查能够知道哪个程序将读取这些字节，并且具备四个属性：

paragraphs.en: it runs at the open and not when a command is launched, because a command names a program and only the open names a file, which requires an enforcement point below the tool surface;
paragraphs.zh: 它是在打开时运行的，而不是在命令启动时运行，因为命令命名的是一个程序，而只有“打开”操作命名的是一个文件，这需要在工具层以下设置一个执行点；

paragraphs.en: it does not pass down to programs the reader starts, because a child that inherits its parent’s permission is the confused deputy [ 9 ] , the old problem in which a trusted program does on an untrusted one’s behalf what the untrusted one may not do itself, which requires a way of tagging processes that survives the creation of new ones;
paragraphs.zh: 它不会向下传递给读者启动的程序，因为继承其父程序权限的子程序会成为一个“混淆的代理人”[9]——这是一个老问题：一个受信任的程序代替一个不受信任的程序执行了后者自身无法执行的操作，而这需要一种在创建新进程时仍能保留的进程标记方法；

paragraphs.en: it cannot be satisfied by whichever process starts the consumer, since otherwise the agent grants itself the exemption by starting the compiler, and nothing we surveyed has this property;
paragraphs.zh: 无论哪个进程启动消费者，都无法满足这一要求，因为否则该智能体通过启动编译器就为自己获得了豁免，而我们所考察的任何情况都不具备这一特性；

paragraphs.en: it bounds what the consumer may hand back, because a compiler the agent can invoke, and whose output the agent can read, is a reader by proxy, which is the compiler row in the table.
paragraphs.zh: 它界定了消费者可能返还的内容，因为智能体可以调用、其输出可以被智能体读取的编译器，是一种代理阅读器，也就是表格中的编译器行。

paragraphs.en: The fourth property places the requirement beyond file-open authorization alone. Compiled artifacts are another, conceded for the same reason, because the executable is what the build is for. Any compiled artifact, the executable and the compiler’s intermediate files alike, carries the numerical constants of the models it implements, and with them the routine names and, if built with debugging information, file paths and line tables. Building without debugging information and stripping the symbols narrows that channel to the constants, the usual position of a group that distributes a binary of a proprietary model, though not a guarantee against reverse engineering. Consequently the answer needs a filter on the build’s reply rather than a rule on the file. We name that property here because the rule is incomplete without it, and we do not offer a way to enforce it.

paragraphs.en: The rules name the right paths, but what they act on is a command string, which is a coarser unit than a read. The difference shows up in the denial record. We matched our own session transcripts against the harness’s denial string and deduplicated by the identifier the harness attaches to each tool call. Hence, one refused invocation counts once however many copies of a transcript hold it, while a retried command counts again. The result is 64 denial events over seven weeks of ordinary research work, from the second week of June to the end of July 2026. In 54 of them the refused invocation was a composite, several commands chained in one line, of which only one held a guarded token. Therefore the batch is refused whole, and the commands around the offending one, which no rule objected to, are denied with it. This is the same limitation that keeps the rules from stating the requirement of section 1, since a rule’s name attaches to a command rather than to a read.

paragraphs.en: Two command shapes, shown here with paths and hosts removed, account for most of the composites. The first is a transfer folded into a chain of ordinary work, cd <dir> && rsync -av <host>:<path> . && ls -l , where the transfer trips the rule that confines the agent to one remote directory, and the two commands around it are refused with it. The second is a rebuild, rm -rf <build> && cmake -S . -B <build> && make -j4 , where the deletion trips the destructive-verb gate and takes the configure and the compile down with it. By the rubric’s precedence, 28 of the 64 are confinement boundaries, 26 the destructive-verb gate, five deliberate probes of a boundary, four a protected target, and one fits none of these headings.
paragraphs.zh: 两种命令结构（此处展示了移除路径和主机后的形式）构成了大多数组合。 第一种是将传输操作折叠进一条普通工作链：cd <dir> && rsync -av <host>:<path> . && ls -l。其中，传输操作触发了将智能体限制在单个远程目录的规则，而围绕它的两条命令也因此被拒绝执行。 第二种是重建操作：rm -rf <build> && cmake -S . -B <build> && make -j4。其中，删除操作触发了破坏性动词的判定机制，并将配置和编译步骤一同排除在外。 根据该准则的优先级，64 个中的 28 个属于限制边界，26 个属于破坏性动词判定机制，5 个是对边界的有意探测，4 个是受保护的目标，还有 1 个不属于上述任何类别。

paragraphs.en: Mechanisms that can express the access rule do exist, though none closes the output channel the build opens. Each asks for something an ordinary user does not hold, whether a privileged policy loader for kernel type enforcement, a rewritten language runtime for access control inside a running program, or the harness itself. Deploying any of them requires control of the layer beneath the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 确实存在能够表达访问规则的机制，但没有任何一种机制能关闭构建所打开的输出通道。 每种机制都需要一个普通用户所不具备的东西：无论是用于内核类型强制的权限策略加载器、用于运行程序内部访问控制的改写语言运行时，还是整个框架本身。 部署其中任何一种机制都需要对智能体所在层之下的层级拥有控制权。

paragraphs.en: One 2026 system comes closest, and its source is public. It enforces policy beneath the tool surfaces by hooking operating-system events across the agent’s whole process tree, and it holds both constructs the rule needs. A lineage gate “checks whether the subject descends from a particular process,” and “a child domain inherits all parent rules and may add local rules, labels, or gates, but cannot remove, disable, or weaken any inherited rule” [ 7 ] . So the rule can be written in that system. When the agent starts the compiler, however, the compiler inherits the agent’s label, because the tags propagate through fork and exec, the two system calls by which one process starts another, and the protected file is then denied to the compiler and the build fails. Making the build work means naming the compiler in the rule as an exception, and the agent can then invoke that exception itself and read what the compiler prints. The exception that exists for the build is available to the agent on the same terms.
paragraphs.zh: 2026 年推出的一个系统最接近这一目标，且其源代码是公开的。 它通过在智能体整个进程树中挂钩操作系统事件，在工具表层之下执行策略，并具备规则所需的全部构建要素。 一个谱系门会“检查主体是否源自某个特定进程”，而“子域会继承所有父域规则，并可添加本地规则、标签或门，但不得移除、禁用或削弱任何继承的规则”[7]。 因此，该规则可以在这个系统中编写。 然而，当智能体启动编译器时，编译器会继承智能体的标签，因为标签会通过 fork 和 exec（一个进程启动另一个进程所用的两个系统调用）传播，此时受保护的文件将被拒绝提供给编译器，导致构建失败。 要使构建成功，必须在规则中将编译器作为例外指定，这样智能体就可以自行调用该例外，并读取编译器输出的内容。 为构建而设置的例外，在相同条件下也对智能体开放。

paragraphs.en: Other systems cover parts of it. All of them check where the agent acts or where its output leaves, rather than where a file is opened. AgentSpec, from ICSE 2026, lets a user write rules with triggers, predicates and enforcement actions, evaluated before an agent’s action executes [ 12 ] . Conseca generates a policy for one task and its context and refuses every action outside it [ 13 ] . CaMeL and Fides decide what may leave the system by where the data came from [ 14 , 15 ] . PORTICO binds a repository path to an access mode and a bounded justification episode [ 8 ] , which is the closest match to the rule among the systems surveyed. It models a single consumer, whereas this case has a second reader, the compiler, that keeps opening the bytes. We did not find these systems applied to a requirement whose enforcement point is the read itself.

paragraphs.en: The result has a vendor-specific part and a general part. The exact tool scopes, the rule syntax and the documented exclusions belong to one vendor and change with its releases. paragraphs.en: As section 1 states, this article assesses what the mechanisms an ordinary user has can express and cover. It does not offer an arrangement that holds against a hostile agent. We run this arrangement today, aware of its usefulness and limits. The permission rules are now generated from a single inventory of protected targets, which closes the missing invariant of section 3, and a hook records every command the agent submits, which is the source of the record in section 5. We accept the diagnostics and have not closed the compiler route, so anyone running an arrangement like this one should assume that the build’s own output, the diagnostics and the compiled artifacts alike, is where protected content can still leave.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 1 节所述，本文评估了普通用户可用于表达和覆盖内容的机制。 它并未提供一个能够抵御恶意智能体的方案。 如今我们运行这一方案，并清楚其效用与局限性。 权限规则现在从一个受保护目标的单一清单中生成，这填补了第 3 节中缺失的不变量；同时，一个挂钩会记录智能体提交的每条命令，这也是第 5 节中记录的数据来源。 我们接受了诊断信息，且尚未关闭编译器通道，因此任何运行类似方案的人都应假设：构建本身的输出、诊断信息以及编译后的产物，都是受保护内容可能仍然泄露出去的途径。
